# SubverseLab

> Free, browser-based AI tools for music producers — drum and MIDI generation, arrangement planning, mix measurement, BPM/frequency math, and stem separation. Every tool runs in the browser; nothing to install. Every tool is free; some require a free account, and where a tool applies a daily limit its own guide states it.

SubverseLab publishes independent, single-purpose production tools. Each tool has a written guide describing exactly what it does, how to use it, and what its limits are. The tools do not fabricate measurements or scores: where a tool reports a number, that number is measured from the audio or derived from a stated formula.

## Tools

- [Arrangement GPS](https://subverselab.com/tools/arrangement-gps): Generate a genre-aware arrangement starting point, preview its structure and learn how to rebuild the idea in a DAW.
- [Sensei Drum Generator](https://subverselab.com/tools/sensei): Generate 8-bar MIDI drum patterns in any of 22 genre styles, thin them live with per-channel density knobs, preview them on a 16th-note step sequencer across six drum channels, and export the result…
- [Subverse Mix Check](https://subverselab.com/tools/subverse-mix-check): Evidence-first audio measurement for your mix or master. Direct ITU-R BS.1770 LUFS, sample peak, crest factor, and one-third-octave spectral analysis, compared against a reference track or a genre…
- [Subverse Splitter](https://subverselab.com/tools/subverse-splitter): Separate a track into drums, bass, vocals and other instruments, pull the vocal off a mix, or read a track's tempo and musical key — all in the browser, nothing to install. Separation uses the…
- [Subverse SynthPulse](https://subverselab.com/tools/synthpulse): Generate a 16-step synth pattern across four lead and two bass lanes, evolve it, shape the in-browser sound preview, and export the result as a standard MIDI file for any DAW. Patterns are ranked by…
- [Time & Frequency Sync](https://subverselab.com/tools/time-frequency-sync): Calculate BPM-synced delay and reverb times, key-to-Hz harmonics and sample repitch math, and hear each value before you use it. Runs entirely in your browser — no upload, no server processing, no…

## Guides

- [Arrangement GPS Guide](https://subverselab.com/learn/arrangement-gps): Arrangement GPS is an idea-to-project learning tool: it builds a full, playable arrangement blueprint from a genre and a few style choices, lets you audition it as a schematic preview, and then…
- [Sensei Drum Generator Guide](https://subverselab.com/learn/sensei): Sensei creates an 8-bar, 4/4 drum pattern from a style and its generation controls. The sequencer shows all 8 bars at 16th-note resolution across six channels: Kick, Snare, Hi-hat, Open Hat, Crash…
- [Subverse Mix Check Guide](https://subverselab.com/learn/subverse-mix-check): Mix Check is an evidence-first audio measurement console. You upload a mix or master, and it shows you what the signal actually measures — loudness, peak, spectrum, and mono compatibility — instead…
- [Subverse Splitter Guide](https://subverselab.com/learn/subverse-splitter): Subverse Splitter is a member-only web tool for analysing music and separating a track into stems. It offers three operations:
- [Subverse SynthPulse Guide](https://subverselab.com/learn/synthpulse): SynthPulse writes a 16-step synth pattern across six lanes: four lead voices and two bass voices. You choose a direction, the tool proposes a pattern, and you export it as a standard MIDI file. It…
- [Time & Frequency Sync Guide](https://subverselab.com/learn/time-frequency-sync): Time and Frequency Sync is a high-precision calculator for music producers, beatmakers, and mixing engineers: BPM-synced delay times, acoustic reverb decay, harmonic frequency values, and sample…
